statement.text:
Let G be a finite soluble group with triality, which means that G admits
a group of automorphisms S isomorphic to the symmetric group of degree 3 given by
the presentation S = ⟨σ, ρ | σ 2 = ρ3 = 1; σρσ = ρ2 ⟩ such that m · mρ · mρ = 1 for
all m in the set of commutators M (G) := {[g, σ] | g ∈ G}.
    Suppose in addition that G = [G, S], the group G is generated by d elements of
M (G) and their images under S, and xn = 1 for all x ∈ M (G). Is it true that the
Fitting height of G is bounded in terms of d and n?
    An affirmative answer would provide a reduction of the analogue of the Restricted
Burnside Problem for Moufang loops to the nilpotent case.
                                                    A. N. Grishkov, A. V. Zavarnitsine
